text:
Priya: Heads up - sudden spike hitting eu-central-3 inference pool, many inference pods Pending and user 502/503s. Observed increased queuing on frontends. :rotating_light:

Sam: Can you paste scheduler events + nodepool status? Need `kubectl describe` snippet.

Priya: Events excerpt:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason             Age    From               Message
  ----     ------             ----   ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling   2m     default-scheduler  0/96 nodes are available: 96 Insufficient accelerators (nvidia-a100-v5).
  Normal   ScalingUp          90s    cluster-autoscaler  Triggered scale-up: need 12 nodes for 36 pods
  Warning  LaunchFailed       45s    node-provisioner    Spot capacity exhausted for nvidia-a100-v5 in eu-central-3
```

Marta: Looks like spot exhaustion for the v5 SKU. Autoscaler requested nodes but provider returned capacity errors. This is consistent with the nightly HPC batch window.

infra-bot: [autoscaler] Scale attempt at 1932156800: requested=+12 launched=0 reason=SpotCapacityExhausted

Lee: Is there any scheduling taint or nodeSelector mismatch? Last deploy added a taint for gpu-exclusive.

Priya: No taint mismatch. Pending due to accelerator shortage only.

Sam: Two problems: 1) autoscaler backoff causes ~3-5m scale-up lag when launches fail; 2) no automatic fallback to on-demand or another region when spot fails. Both amplify outage.

Carlos: Immediate mitigations: A) divert a portion of traffic to us-west-2 on-demand pool, B) enable CPU-quantized model variant for non-critical routes to reduce accelerator demand, C) request short-term on-demand quota bump.

Marta: I'll flip route split and enable fallback variant for the canary `/v1/gen/light` path. Starting with 25% shift to us-west-2.

Priya: Route-shift executed:
```
POST https://ops-api.internal/route-shift
{ "route": "/v1/gen/light", "percent": 25, "dest": "us-west-2" }
```
CPU-fallback enabled for `lightweight` model variant.

Sam: Patching autoscaler policy now: reduce exponential backoff on launch failures, and add rule: if provider returns SpotCapacityExhausted within 5m -> trigger immediate on-demand fallback for affected nodepool.

Lee: Add alert: metric `autoscaler.zero_launches` > 1 within 10 minutes -> page infra-oncall.

Carlos: Cost heads-up: moving to on-demand will increase GPU spend ~2x for the window. I opened a spend-override with finance. They approved up to 3 hours provisional.

infra-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-193215, severity=P2, owner=infra-oncall

Marta: Observability: I've added a short dashboard tile showing `scale_requests`, `launched_nodes`, `provider_errors` to make SpotCapacityExhausted visible in the console.

Sam: I'll push a small autoscaler PR with unit tests simulating provider reject responses. Also adding an integration test to ensure fallbacks trigger.

Priya: 1932156920 check: after route shift 25% to us-west-2, 503s dropped 78% overall. EU pending pods slowly decreasing as a small on-demand bump succeeded (3 nodes launched).

Lee: Tracking scheduler events. If Pending > 10 for 5m, escalate to SRE lead.

Carlos: Keeping finance looped. If on-demand persists beyond 3h we'll revert to weighted routing and deeper model-fallback.

Priya: Current status 1932157123: user-facing errors normalized, EU Pending down to 2. Keeping thread open for follow-ups and the autoscaler policy change PR.

Sam: Action items: Sam -> autoscaler PR + infra ticket for quota. Marta -> finish route split & dashboard. Lee -> alert. Carlos -> finalize spend override. Priya -> monitor until 1932158000. 

Priya: Thanks everyone. Postmortem note: add automatic region-failover or GPU-fallback policy when SpotCapacityExhausted seen more than twice in 30m. :white_check_mark:
